description: This file defines an API client for a Flutter-based application, providing methods for HTTP GET and POST requests, handling responses, and managing errors. It includes an exception class and a class for API interactions with support for authorization tokens and environment configuration.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, carrying HTTP status, message, URI, and cause.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class providing methods for performing HTTP GET and POST requests with support for tokens, default headers, and response handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request, returning the decoded JSON response or raw text.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON body, returning the decoded JSON response or raw text.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full URI from a base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Creates a headers map merging default headers, authorization token, and additional headers.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles HTTP responses, parsing JSON when appropriate, and throws ApiException on errors.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Creates a truncated preview of a string for logging purposes.
